$comment: Per-repo values for the sydevs `workflow` plugin and its skills. This file holds only values. The skills hold the rules that use these values. The docs/ folder holds the explanations.

contractStep.description: This step consumes the generated types from SahajCloud main. It runs no migrations.

securityReview.rationale: Server-side rendering, preview routes, and the deploy/build configuration.

worktreeNotes: Copy .env and .dev.vars from the main checkout when the branch needs them.

generatedFiles.reason: `pnpm types:cms` generates `server/payload-types.ts`. It curls the schema from SahajCloud main and strips the module augmentation. Do not hand-edit this file. To change CMS types, first change the upstream schema and merge it. See /cross-repo-issue. For app-specific types, use `server/cms-types.ts`.
`dist/` holds build output from `pnpm build`. Change the source and rebuild.
pnpm generates `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Use `pnpm add`, `pnpm remove`, or `pnpm update` instead of editing it directly.
